svg.title: Payload anatomy: one synthetic Bangla QR payload, annotated tag by tag
svg.desc: A 265-character synthetic DEMO STORE NPSB payload wrapped at tag boundaries. Each 4-character TTLL header is underlined and labelled with its tag id, tag name, syntax and the fixture value.
svg.text: One dummy payload, tag by tag
fixture · 265 characters · wrapped at tag boundaries · every value fake

g.text: 4 uppercase hex, computed over all the rest

svg.text: Underline = each field's 4-character TTLL header (2-digit tag + 2-digit length); labels quote the fixture's actual bytes.
